children: The cost of insuring Saudi Arabia's sovereign debt against default edges higher after Houthi militants captured a Red Sea port late Thursday, an important route for Saudi's oil exports. The militants earlier this week attacked energy facilities in Saudi Arabia, raising concerns about the spread of the Middle East conflict. Saudi Arabia's 5-year sovereign credit default swaps climb 1 basis point to 59bps, the highest in three weeks, S&P Global Market Intelligence data show. (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
